features.text: DYNAMIC PATELLA TRACKING: Offset hinge and patella support help reduce runner’s knee and patellofemoral pain.
CUSTOM STRAP CONTROL: Adjustable straps and anti slip grips help keep the brace in place as you move.
LIGHTWEIGHT, BREATHABLE BUILD: About 7 oz for comfortable wear during training or daily activity.
NATURAL RANGE OF MOTION: Flexible hinge supports the joint without limiting stride.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PDAC APPROVED L1820: Eligible for insurance reimbursement (check with your provider).
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
